device.description: 16-bit 500 MSPS 2x-8x interpolating dual current-output DAC with NCO, QMC, dual 16-bit CMOS data inputs and 3/4-wire serial configuration port
device.note: dac5687.pdf (SLWS164E) p.3 pinout, p.4-5 terminal functions, p.8 power supply ranges, p.10 serial port timing, p.24-31 register map and descriptions, p.32-33 serial interface (Tables 6-7, Figures 33-34)

registers.name: RESERVED_1D
registers.note: reserved: writes have no effect, reads 0x00

registers.name: RESERVED_1E
registers.note: reserved: writes have no effect, reads 0x00

registers.name: RESERVED_1F
registers.note: reserved: writes have no effect, reads 0x00

registers.name: DATA_A
registers.note: the 16-bit ser_data value (SER_DATA_1:SER_DATA_0) that replaces both DAC inputs when CONFIG3.DAC_SER_DATA = 1; written together with SER_DATA_0/1

registers.name: DATA_B
registers.note: the 16-bit ser_data value (SER_DATA_1:SER_DATA_0) that replaces both DAC inputs when CONFIG3.DAC_SER_DATA = 1; written together with SER_DATA_0/1

protocol.note: instruction byte R/W N1 N0 A4..A0, then N+1 data bytes MSB first; the address decrements per byte (one command per start address and length). Writes of SER_DATA_0/1 are copied into DATA_A/DATA_B

pages: p.3 (pinout), p.4-5 (terminal functions), p.8 (supply ranges), p.10 (serial port timing, td(Data) 10 ns), p.24-31 (register map), p.32-33 (serial interface)
notModeled: DAC data path: DA[15:0]/DB[15:0] (latched by CLK1 / PLLLOCK, FIFO) are not modeled because the clocked data bus cannot run beside the serial port (bus and configBus share one command decoder); the DAC registers DATA_A/DATA_B hold the serial ser_data word (SER_DATA_1:SER_DATA_0), which drives both DACs only when CONFIG3.DAC_SER_DATA = 1

interpolation, NCO, coarse mixer, QMC gain/phase/offset, inverse sinc, counter mode, half-rate and interleaved input: stored only; offset/QMC registers take effect only after DACA_OFFSET_0 is written (not modeled)
clock generation (PLL, PLLVDD strap, external / dual-clock modes, FIFO, PLLLOCK output, atest clock outputs), PHSTR / QFLAG / TXENABLE synchronization; TXENABLE low forcing the data path to 0
4-pin serial mode (CONFIG3.SIF_4PIN = 1: SDO output, SDIO input only) is not modeled: read data always comes out on SDIO (3-pin mode, the reset default); SDO stays low
multibyte transfers whose decrementing address would pass below 0x00 are ignored (not specified)
SLEEP pin and sleep_daca/sleep_dacb (analog power-down); TESTMODE must be DGND
DVDD (1.71-2.15 V core supply) lies inside the IOVDD vcc range 1.71-3.6 V and is treated as a digital supply
variants: dac5687-ep.pdf (SGLS333, DAC5687-EP, -55 to 125 C, part DAC5687MPZPEP) describes the same chip; the commercial datasheet dac5687.pdf (rev E, newer) is used. DAC5686 is the pin-compatible predecessor.
